systems.system: national data centre TI3 at Koloma

GIN.note: The Koloma national data centre is stated as under construction, not in service.
The 585-school connection programme covers public primary schools only, so it is not a rural access programme under the study.

facts.fact: The pre-university education minister listed the extension of the national fibre-optic backbone among the major works the ministry has engaged, at the 5 November 2025 launch.
